contentType.description: Content type. Please see {@link ContentMeta} and {@link ContentType} for more information

contentEncoding.description:
Currently only allows gzip compression
This should only be used when the file is being written to S3

order.description:
Order expression.
Doesn't work with cassandra target types in BatchExportSpec

limit.description:
Limit the number of objects to export.
Doesn't work with cassandra target types in BatchExportSpec

csvHeader.description:
Header when exported data as csv.
Required if the content type is csv

csvFormat.description: Optional format for a csv values. Key should be path used in a csv header.

xmlInclude.description:
Include spec when exporting data as xml.
Works only with {@link Persistable#exportData} function

jsonInclude.description:
Include spec when exporting data as json.
Works only with {@link Persistable#exportData} function

title:
Specification of the options/parameters used by {@link Persistable#exportData} and {@link Export#startExport}
function.
name: ExportDataCommonSpec
